sections.content:
Notice that feminine nouns beginning with a stressed 'a' or 'ha' take the masculine article 'el' in the singular to avoid awkward vowel blending, but remain feminine in plural and with adjectives:

• El aula (classroom) → Las aulas (plural)
• El aula magna (The main lecture hall — adjective remains feminine)

sections.title: Campus Vocabulary Patterns
rows: La clase tiene lugar en el aula 3.
Me matriculé en tres cursos este semestre.
Carlos solicitó una beca de intercambio.
